title: DROA-CLIPSeg: Prompt-Guided Thin Crack Segmentation in Low-Light Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2610.33635v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pavement crack segmentation under low light is degraded by reduced contrast, shadows, headlight glare, joints, stains, and wet seams. Existing crack segmentation methods mostly assume good illumination. Low-light enhancement methods improve visual quality, but they do not explicitly preserve crack topology. To address these limitations, we formulate low-light crack segmentation as a degradation-aware, prompt-grounded structural defect segmentation problem and propose DROA-CLIPSeg, a parameter-efficient framework that adapts a frozen CLIPSeg vision language backbone using two lightweight modules. QKV Low-Rank Adaptation is injected into the Q/K/V projections of the vision and text encoders to improve crack-specific image text alignment without backbone fine-tuning. The proposed Domain Residual Orthogonal Adapter (DROA) decomposes intermediate features into a dominant crack-domain branch, which captures recurring low-light crack patterns

translated_title: DROA-CLIPSeg：基于提示引导的低光照条件下细微裂缝分割
translated_abstract: 低光照条件下的路面裂缝分割会因对比度降低、阴影、车灯眩光、接缝、污渍和潮湿缝隙而性能下降。现有的裂缝分割方法大多假设光照条件良好。低光照增强方法虽然能改善视觉质量，但并未显式地保留裂缝的拓扑结构。为解决这些局限性，我们将低光照裂缝分割表述为一个退化感知、基于提示引导的结构缺陷分割问题，并提出DROA-CLIPSeg——一个参数高效的框架，它利用两个轻量级模块对冻结的CLIPSeg视觉-语言主干进行适配。其中，QKV低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation）被注入到视觉和文本编码器的Q/K/V投影中，以在不微调主干的情况下改进针对裂缝的图像-文本对齐。所提出的域残差正交适配器（DROA）将中间特征分解为主导的裂缝域分支，该分支能够捕获低光照条件下裂缝的常见模式。
tldr: 提出DROA-CLIPSeg框架，通过QKV低秩适配和域残差正交适配器（DROA）两个轻量模块高效适配冻结的CLIPSeg视觉-语言主干，实现低光照条件下基于提示引导的细微路面裂缝分割。
en_tdlr: Proposes DROA-CLIPSeg, a parameter-efficient framework that adapts a frozen CLIPSeg vision-language backbone via QKV Low-Rank Adaptation and a Domain Residual Orthogonal Adapter to enable prompt-guided thin crack segmentation under low-light conditions.
